name: That Yellow Cartoon Pack
description:
Hi, everybody! From the town of [[REDACTED]], we bring you the [[REDACTED]] Hunnys Closet Pack, better known as... That Yellow Cartoon Pack! (That name again is That Yellow Cartoon Pack!)



Missing out on this stylized, hilarious, cartoonish Pack of loveable outfits, hairstyles, dyes, and more, will leave you saying D'oh!




Owning this unlocks the following set of 12 Hunnys Closet Items & Dyes (for use on all Hunnys Closet items):

Dye: Beer

Dye: Cartoon Blue 1

Dye: Cartoon Blue 2

Dye: Drunkard Brown

Dye: Drunkard Orange

Skin: That Yellow Cartoon Skin

Eyebrows: Heavy Brow

Eyes: Drunkard Gaze

Hair Style: Drunkard Hair

Hand: Beer

Mouth: Drunkard Buckteeth

Outfit: Drunkard Shirt




All pieces purchased within this Hunnys Closet Shop collection will immediately unlock the specified item(s) for use in the [Hunnys Closet](https://closet.hunnys.io).



As long as you currently hold this token in the same wallet that you are connected with when using the [Hunnys Closet](https://closet.hunnys.io), it will automatically be available for use - enjoy!
